title: Release Blocker Door
altText: Official NIST AI RMF excerpts requiring a proceed-or-stop determination and mechanisms to supersede, disengage or deactivate systems with outcomes inconsistent with intended use.
caption: NIST AI RMF release boundary: decide whether deployment should proceed and deactivate systems whose outcomes conflict with intended use.
credit: Tabassi, E. (2023), Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), NIST AI 100-1, p. 32. Republished courtesy of NIST.
claimBoundary: Supports a go/no-go and deactivate release boundary; it does not certify Build 032’s blocker logic or any release decision.
noEndorsement: Use only the exact document treatment under its recorded terms. Exclude logos, seals, people and third-party material; attribution does not imply that National Institute of Standards and Technology endorses RN or Build 032.
